description: React component for updating user group details via a modal dialog, including form handling, validation, and API interaction.

classes.name: UpdateUserGroupModal
classes.description: React functional component for editing a user group in a modal dialog.

methods.name: isSaveEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the save button should be enabled based on form state.

methods.name: updateNameState
methods.description: Updates the group name state and auto-generates mention if not manually updated.

methods.name: updateMentionState
methods.description: Updates the mention state and marks it as manually updated.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation, invoking callback and closing modal.

methods.name: patchGroup
methods.description: Validates input and sends patch request to update the group; handles errors.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events, triggers save on Enter key.

methods.name: onSaveClick
methods.description: Handles save button click, triggers patchGroup.

methods.name: onBackClick
methods.description: Handles back button click, triggers goBack.
